description: This file defines the FormRecordable interface for the OpenMRS project. It declares methods for getting and setting form field namespace and path details, acting as a bridge between an OpenMrsObject and its position in a form.

classes.name: FormRecordable
classes.description: Interface defining methods for accessing and setting form field namespace and path details within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: getFormFieldNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace associated with the form field, or null if not specified.

methods.name: getFormFieldPath
methods.description: Returns the path for the form field, or null if not specified.

methods.name: setFormField
methods.description: Sets the namespace and path for the form field used to capture observation details, with validation for length and separator constraints.
